headline: AMD stock slides after Intel earnings reveal two big issues
detail: This is a direct hit to the chip sector, suggesting broader weakness or competitive pressures. Your portfolio is heavily concentrated in chip names (SMH, SMCI, SOXL, MUU), making this highly relevant.
rec: Given the sector weakness and your SMH position (price 533.88, stop 540) being close to its stop, consider trimming SMH to manage risk.

headline: Cost of money on the ballot as voters struggle with debt
detail: This highlights rising interest rate concerns, which can slow economic growth and hurt growth-oriented tech firms. As you're on margin, higher rates also increase your borrowing costs and make drawdowns more painful.
rec: Your SPY position is up 3.65% and marked 'TRIM.' Consider taking some profit to reduce overall market exposure and free up capital in a rising rate environment.

headline: Bitcoin slides after historic $6.3 billion crypto heist
detail: This event signals increased risk aversion in speculative assets and could spill over into broader tech sentiment. While not directly holding crypto, your leveraged tech/chip positions are sensitive to shifts in market sentiment.
rec: No direct trade from this headline, but watch your QQQ (price 698.46, stop 670) and other leveraged tech ETFs for potential follow-through weakness.
